detail.visual: Left-facing bomber above falling bombs that grow toward foreground; F inside circle on each large bomb; distressed olive/black graphic.
detail.sales_basis: 13 exact-product reviews; verified buyer entries February 11 and January 6 2024, plus Shop-verified September 10 2025. Top 83-review label not used.

supplemental_searches.result: Irrelevant generic shirt results; no origin evidence credited.

Directly viewed m00nshot comparator: right-facing propeller bomber above four increasingly large F-marked bombs; different plane, bomb drawings and stars. Material specific wording/action/perspective/punchline recurrence; not an exact artwork identity claim.

decision.basis: Six mandatory searches complete. Supplemental targeted apparel search and direct m00nshot comparison establish the same distinctive lettered-bomb pun enacted by a bomber dropping progressively larger F bombs. Drawings differ; no exact-copy or priority finding. Solid Threads general original-design claim does not resolve this cross-seller expression recurrence. Common letter and dictionary idiom alone are not the quarantine basis.
decision.limitations: No infringement finding. Query wording is the printed F rather than inferred phrase. Required results are kept separate from supplemental apparel results. Continue same-store queue 2.
